document.abstract: The Second International Workshop on HDTV was held in L'Aquila, Italy, February 29 through March 3, 1988. The sessions, which focused on signal processing, attracted over 40 papers and more than 110 participants. The program was further enhanced with simulations of various systems, provided to support the papers sessions.
